title: Beyond Accuracy: Disentangling Decomposition from Typed-State Quality Assurance in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines
title_zh: 超越准确率：在多智能体LLM流水线中将分解与类型化状态质量保证解耦

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent LLM pipelines are often credited with gains in software engineering tasks, but it is rarely clear whether a gain stems from the typed contract between agents or from the specialized prompts that decomposition enables. We study this attribution problem in Requirements Engineering, comparing three architectures for classifying requirements as functional or non-functional and then prioritizing them with MoSCoW: a single-call baseline; a two-call variant that reuses the pipeline’s specialized prompts but passes an unvalidated intermediate; and a pipeline with a Pydantic-validated typed state. The 18 conditions cover PROMISE NFR+ (625 requirements), three locally hosted small language models, and two languages. The F1 gain over the baseline is associated with the two-call, specialized-prompt variant (up to + 0.075 +0.075 ), whereas the typed state adds a small difference ( − 0.003 -0.003 to + 0.013 +0.013 ) that is significant in one of six comparisons. Beyond accuracy, the typed pipeline contains out-of-range model outputs at the agent boundary, while the unvalidated variant fails later and drops the requirement, and it shows a small, reproducible increase in inter-model MoSCoW consistency whose cause our design cannot isolate. The study is associative: the contrasts bundle prompts, call count, and staged context, and the results come from three 7–8B models on one dataset. The implementation and replication package are archived on Zenodo ( https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23380444 ).
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体 LLM 流水线常被认为能在软件工程任务中带来收益，但收益究竟来自智能体之间的类型化契约，还是来自任务分解所支持的专用提示词，往往并不清楚。 我们在需求工程领域研究这一归因问题，比较了三种用于将需求分类为功能性或非功能性、随后按 MoSCoW 进行优先级排序的架构：单次调用基线；复用流水线专用提示词但传递未经验证的中间结果的两次调用变体；以及具有 Pydantic 验证的类型化状态的流水线。 这 18 种实验条件涵盖 PROMISE NFR+ 数据集（625 条需求）、三个本地托管的小型语言模型和两种语言。 相对基线的 F1 提升与两次调用的专用提示词变体相关（最高 +0.075），而类型化状态带来的差异很小（−0.003 到 +0.013），且仅在六组比较中的一组中显著。 除准确性之外，类型化流水线能在智能体边界处拦截超出范围的模型输出，而未经验证的变体会在后续阶段失败并丢弃该需求；此外，它还显示出智能体间 MoSCoW 一致性的小幅可复现提升，但其成因无法由我们的设计加以分离。 本研究是关联性的：各对比条件将提示词、调用次数与分阶段上下文捆绑在一起，且结果仅来自单一数据集上的三个 7–8B 模型。 实现与复现包已归档于 Zenodo（https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23380444）。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as components of larger software pipelines, where their outputs feed downstream decisions with limited human review ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . This raises a quality assurance question that has received little controlled empirical attention in the Brazilian Software Quality community: when a pipeline is decomposed into specialised agents connected by a typed contract, what does that contract buy beyond the accuracy of the underlying model calls? Recent SBQS work shares the evaluate-beyond-accuracy concern in adjacent settings, such as judging LLM-generated unit tests against mutation-testing criteria ( Cabral et al., 2025 ) and assessing generative AI as a substitute for usability inspectors ( Campos et al., 2025 ) . Practitioners likewise cite reliability and weak contextual grounding as primary barriers to adopting LLMs in Requirements Engineering ( Santos et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: None of the studies we surveyed isolates the contribution of an architectural mechanism, such as a typed inter-agent contract, from that of prompt design. When a pipeline outperforms a single-agent baseline, the gain is often read as evidence that the contract improves output quality; whether prompting alone would produce the same gain is rarely checked, and systematic reviews confirm that this conflation remains unresolved ( Zadenoori et al., 2025a ; Hemmat et al., 2025 ) (§ 3 ). F1 is not this paper’s object of interest but the instrument we use to rule out one explanation before asking a more specific question: we show that the typed contract barely moves F1 ( Δ s ≈ 0 \Delta_{\text{s}}\approx 0 ), which points to decomposition and its task-specific prompts as the accuracy driver and leaves open what differences accompany the typed contract, a question F1 cannot answer (§ 6.5 , § 6.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们调研的研究中，没有任何一项将架构机制（例如类型化的智能体间契约）的贡献与提示词设计的贡献分离开来。 当一个流水线优于单智能体基线时，这一提升往往被解读为契约能改善输出质量的证据；而仅靠提示是否也能产生同样的提升却很少被检验，系统性综述也证实这种混淆仍未得到解决（Zadenoori et al., 2025a；Hemmat et al., 2025）（§ 3）。 F1 并非本文关注的研究对象，而是我们在提出更具体的问题之前用来排除一种解释的工具：我们证明类型化契约几乎不改变 F1（Δ s ≈ 0 \Delta_{\text{s}}\approx 0），这表明任务分解及其任务特定提示才是准确率的驱动因素，同时也留下一个 F1 无法回答的问题——类型化契约伴随哪些差异（§ 6.5、§ 6.6）。

paragraphs.en: We therefore ask not only whether a multi-agent pipeline refines classification accuracy, but which architectural element drives any gain and what differences accompany the typed contract. We operationalise quality assurance narrowly, as early structural validation and cross-model behavioural consistency, loosely related to ISO/IEC 25010’s Reliability (we do not measure Maintainability ) rather than the Functional Suitability that F1 already captures. We compare three architectures on FR/NFR classification followed by MoSCoW prioritisation, using PROMISE NFR+ ( Silva et al., 2024a ; Silva et al., 2024b ) (625 requirements): a baseline that issues a single LLM call per requirement; a pipeline of two specialised agents orchestrated with LangGraph ( LangChain, 2024 ) over a Pydantic-validated typed state; and a two-call baseline that reuses the pipeline’s task-specific prompts but passes an unvalidated intermediate object. Because the second call also receives the first call’s decided type and category, the baseline-to-two-call difference is a decomposition effect that bundles prompt wording, call count, and staged context (§ 4.5 , § 6.5 ). All three run on the same three locally served SLMs and decoding settings, yielding an 18-condition grid (3 models × \times 3 architectures × \times 2 languages).
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们不仅考察多智能体流水线是否能提升分类准确率，还要探究究竟是哪个架构要素带来了提升，以及类型化契约伴随产生了哪些差异。 我们将质量保障狭义地定义为早期的结构验证与跨模型行为一致性，这与 ISO/IEC 25010 的可靠性（Reliability）大致相关（我们不测量可维护性/Maintainability），而非 F1 已经涵盖的功能适用性（Functional Suitability）。 我们在 FR/NFR 分类及后续 MoSCoW 优先级排序任务上比较三种架构，使用 PROMISE NFR+（Silva et al., 2024a; Silva et al., 2024b）（625 条需求）：一是每条需求仅发起一次 LLM 调用的基线；二是由 LangGraph（LangChain, 2024）编排、基于 Pydantic 校验的类型化状态的两个专用智能体组成的流水线；三是两步调用的基线，它复用流水线中面向任务的提示词，但传递未经校验的中间对象。 由于第二次调用也接收第一次调用所判定的类型与类别，基线与两步调用之间的差异是一种分解效应，其中捆绑了提示词措辞、调用次数和分阶段上下文（§4.5、§6.5）。 三者均在相同的三台本地部署的 SLM 与相同的解码设置上运行，构成一个 18 种条件的网格（3 个模型 × 3 种架构 × 2 种语言）。

paragraphs.en: Contributions. (1) A controlled empirical study (18 conditions, n = 625 n=625 ; paired McNemar and Wilcoxon tests, Cohen’s h h and paired g g , Bonferroni; Fleiss’ κ \kappa with a paired bootstrap; and a sensitivity analysis retaining parse-failure fallbacks) that separates the accuracy effect of decomposition from the quality-assurance properties that accompany a typed contract, corroborated by a direct baseline-vs-two-call comparison (§ 6.5 ). (2) Evidence that a near-zero F1 difference does not make the typed contract dispensable, restricted to two properties: containment of out-of-range fields at the agent boundary (classification faults one call earlier than the unvalidated ablation), verified by fault injection (§ 6.6 ), and a small, statistically confirmed increase in inter-model MoSCoW consistency (§ 6.3 ). Confidence-aware routing, the other mechanism the design attributes to the typed state, fired for only 3 of 3,750 pipeline predictions (all parse fallbacks), so it is validated only through the synthetic fault-injection test, not on the PROMISE NFR+ grid. (3) An open-source pipeline built on a reusable BaseAgent[Item, Output] abstraction. (4) A replication package (prompts, runner, manifests, raw predictions for all 36 executions, analysis scripts, tests) archived on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23380444 ).

paragraphs.en: LLM-based agents. LLMs have evolved from passive text generators into agents that invoke tools, maintain state, and work with other agents ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Multi-agent systems compose such agents into pipelines in which each handles a sub-task and communicates through typed messages or shared state, reflecting classical design principles (task specialisation, typed contracts, composability). Their empirical benefit remains open, since shared context may offset the gains of decomposition, and it splits into two facets that this paper treats separately: functional accuracy , and quality attributes (e.g., ISO/IEC 25010 Reliability ) that an accuracy metric does not capture.

paragraphs.en: Recent work has investigated the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Requirements Engineering (RE) for tasks such as the classification of functional and non-functional requirements (FR/NFR), prioritization, traceability, and requirements generation. However, most studies evaluate the models as standalone predictors and emphasize classification accuracy, paying less attention to the architectural mechanisms that coordinate multiple interactions between LLMs. FR/NFR classification has been extensively investigated using the PROMISE NFR+ benchmark ( Silva et al., 2024a ; Silva et al., 2024b ) . Recent studies compare proprietary and open-source models under various prompting strategies ( Martin et al., 2025 ) , combine fine-tuned Small Language Models (SLMs) with explainability techniques ( Rejithkumar and Anish, 2025 ) , and analyze performance differences between compact and proprietary models ( Zadenoori et al., 2025b ) . In general, these works aim to improve predictive performance while keeping the underlying processing architecture unchanged. From a broader perspective, systematic reviews by Zadenoori et al. ( Zadenoori et al., 2025a ) and Hemmat et al. ( Hemmat et al., 2025 ) identify growing interest in the use of LLMs in RE but also point out a lack of rigorous, reproducible evaluations of architectural design decisions. Concurrently, LLM-based multi-agent systems are gaining traction in software engineering tasks, driven by the decomposition of work among specialized agents and explicit orchestration mechanisms ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Although existing studies often report end-to-end performance gains, few isolate the effects of decomposition and the architectural decisions governing agent interaction. This work addresses this attribution problem through a controlled experimental design. We compare three configurations: a single-call baseline, a multi-agent pipeline with typed contracts between agents, and a two-call baseline without typed state. By keeping the underlying models and decoding configurations constant, the design makes it possible to distinguish the effects of task-specific decomposition and prompting from those associated with the typed contract between agents. The gap we claim is relative to the two systematic reviews above and to SBQS/SBES proceedings of 2024–2025; our survey was not systematic.
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究已经探讨了将大语言模型（LLM）用于需求工程（RE）中的任务，例如功能需求与非功能需求（FR/NFR）的分类、优先级排序、可追溯性以及需求生成。 然而，大多数研究将这些模型作为独立的预测器进行评估，并强调分类准确率，较少关注协调LLM之间多次交互的架构机制。 FR/NFR分类已基于PROMISE NFR+基准（Silva et al., 2024a；Silva et al., 2024b）得到了广泛研究。 近期研究在各种提示策略下比较专有模型与开源模型（Martin et al., 2025），将经过微调的小语言模型（SLM）与可解释性技术相结合（Rejithkumar and Anish, 2025），并分析了紧凑模型与专有模型之间的性能差异（Zadenoori et al., 2025b）。 总体而言，这些工作旨在提升预测性能，同时保持底层处理架构不变。 从更宏观的视角来看，Zadenoori等人 （Zadenoori et al., 2025a）和Hemmat等人 （Hemmat et al., 2025）的系统性综述指出，LLM在需求工程中的应用日益受到关注，但同时也指出缺乏对架构设计决策的严谨、可复现的评估。 与此同时，基于LLM的多智能体系统正在软件工程任务中获得关注，其驱动力来自于在专门化智能体之间分解工作以及显式的编排机制（Liu et al., 2026）。 尽管现有研究常常报告端到端的性能提升，但很少有研究隔离工作分解的作用以及控制智能体交互的架构决策的影响。 本工作通过受控实验设计来解决这一归因问题。 我们比较三种配置：单次调用基线、智能体之间具有类型化契约的多智能体流水线，以及没有类型化状态的两次调用基线。 通过保持底层模型与解码配置不变，该设计能够将任务特定分解与提示所带来的效果，同智能体之间类型化契约所带来的效果区分开来。 我们所声称的空白是相对于上述两篇系统性综述以及2024–2025年的SBQS/SBES会议论文集而言的；我们的调研并非系统性的。

paragraphs.en: The pipeline consists of ClassificationAgent and PrioritizationAgent . Agents process requirements in a pool of three workers, retry each call up to three times with exponential back-off, and preserve input order; the global rank is recomputed by sorting on priority_score . paragraphs.en: Small models frequently return malformed or off-schema JSON. Every agent extracts the outermost JSON object with a regular expression (duplicated in each agent rather than centralised). The classification-producing agents additionally normalise the category (mapping Portuguese or English prose to the PROMISE code) and repair a recurrent off-schema pattern in which the model returns an NFR category code (e.g., PE ) in the requirement-type field, reading it as NF. The repair was needed only by mistral:7b , in 16 of 625 PT and 7 of 625 EN outputs, with identical counts in the pipeline classifier and the two-call baseline. If parsing or validation still fails, the agent returns a deterministic fallback instead of raising: FUNCTIONAL with confidence zero for classification and COULD_HAVE with score 0.5 for prioritisation, so a batch is never aborted. paragraphs.en: The unit tests cover agent parsing, category normalisation and fallbacks, the domain models, the runner and manifest, the statistical routines, the language rule (a test fails if any agent sends Portuguese text in an English condition), and the confidence rule (the pipeline’s prioritiser receives the classifier’s confidence; the two-call baseline fixes it at 1.0). A fault-injection campaign injects 13 faults (six value-range violations, e.g. confidence 1.4 1.4 or priority_score − 0.1 -0.1 , and seven parse-level faults); the tests assert that the typed pipeline contains each value-range violation at the agent boundary, whereas the unvalidated intermediate fails only when the output model is assembled (§ 6.6 ).

paragraphs.en: Five aspects bound what the experiments can attribute. First, confidence-aware routing is wired but almost never fires: only three of 3,750 pipeline predictions (two for qwen2.5:7b PT, one for mistral:7b EN, all parse fallbacks excluded from the metrics) have confidence below 0.70 0.70 , so its isolated effect cannot be evaluated; the two-call baseline fixes the confidence at 1.0. Second, response parsing is regex-based and duplicated across agents, so a response with several brace-delimited blocks fails extraction and becomes a fallback. Third, seed governs dataset sampling only and is not forwarded to the model server, so determinism rests on temperature 0. Fourth, agents write their results into the shared state object in place. Fifth, we evaluated the design only in RE, although we expect the principles to apply to other multi-stage SE tasks.

paragraphs.en: Two research questions guide this study, complemented by a language-effect analysis (§ 6.2 ) that is reported alongside the RQs but is not itself a formal RQ, since it varies text language and prompt language jointly rather than isolating either as a controlled factor.

paragraphs.en: RQ1. To what extent does the pipeline outperform the single-agent baseline in FR/NFR binary classification? We report Macro F1 and test the paired per-requirement outcomes across the six model–language combinations with the Wilcoxon signed-rank test (confidence-zero fallbacks excluded) and the exact McNemar test (fallbacks retained), with Bonferroni correction ( α ′ = 0.05 / 6 = 0.0083 \alpha^{\prime}=0.05/6=0.0083 ).

paragraphs.en: RQ2 (central). To what extent does decomposition with its task-specific prompts, rather than the typed inter-agent state contract, account for the F1 difference between the pipeline and the single-agent baseline, and what differences accompany the typed state contract that F1 does not capture? We examine this through two architectural contrasts, Δ p = F1(two-call) − F1(baseline) \Delta_{\text{p}}=\text{F1(two-call)}-\text{F1(baseline)} and Δ s = F1(pipeline) − F1(two-call) \Delta_{\text{s}}=\text{F1(pipeline)}-\text{F1(two-call)} . The first bundles task-specific prompts, an additional call, and staged context. The second bundles the typed Pydantic state, its validation boundary, confidence-conditioned prompting (which fired for only 3 of 3,750 pipeline predictions, § 4.5 ), and LangGraph orchestration. Neither contrast isolates a single mechanism, and because the unified baseline prompt and the task-specific prompts cannot be made strictly identical (§ 7 ), Δ s \Delta_{\text{s}} is read as an upper bound on the F1 difference associated with the typed state rather than as a point estimate. Validation and error-propagation behaviour are examined separately (§ 6.5 , § 6.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: RQ2（核心问题）。 带有任务特定提示词的分解在多大程度上（而非类型化的智能体间状态契约）解释了流水线与单智能体基线之间的 F1 差异，以及类型化状态契约伴随哪些 F1 无法刻画的差异？ 我们通过两个架构对比来考察这一问题：Δ p = F1(two-call) − F1(baseline) \Delta_{\text{p}}=\text{F1(two-call)}-\text{F1(baseline)} 与 Δ s = F1(pipeline) − F1(two-call) \Delta_{\text{s}}=\text{F1(pipeline)}-\text{F1(two-call)} 。 第一个对比打包了任务特定提示词、一次额外的调用以及分阶段的上下文。 第二个对比打包了类型化的 Pydantic 状态、其验证边界、以置信度为条件的提示词（在 3,750 条流水线预测中仅有 3 条触发了该机制，见 § 4.5 ），以及 LangGraph 编排。 这两个对比都没有隔离出单一机制，并且由于统一基线提示词与任务特定提示词无法做到严格一致（§ 7 ），因此 Δ s \Delta_{\text{s}} 被解读为与类型化状态相关的 F1 差异的上界，而非点估计。 验证与错误传播行为将单独考察（§ 6.5 、§ 6.6 ）。

sents.zh: 我们通过两个架构对比来考察这一问题：Δ p = F1(two-call) − F1(baseline) \Delta_{\text{p}}=\text{F1(two-call)}-\text{F1(baseline)} 与 Δ s = F1(pipeline) − F1(two-call) \Delta_{\text{s}}=\text{F1(pipeline)}-\text{F1(two-call)} 。

sents.en: The first bundles task-specific prompts, an additional call, and staged context.
sents.zh: 第一个对比打包了任务特定提示词、一次额外的调用以及分阶段的上下文。

sents.en: The second bundles the typed Pydantic state, its validation boundary, confidence-conditioned prompting (which fired for only 3 of 3,750 pipeline predictions, § 4.5 ), and LangGraph orchestration.
sents.zh: 第二个对比打包了类型化的 Pydantic 状态、其验证边界、以置信度为条件的提示词（在 3,750 条流水线预测中仅有 3 条触发了该机制，见 § 4.5 ），以及 LangGraph 编排。

sents.en: Neither contrast isolates a single mechanism, and because the unified baseline prompt and the task-specific prompts cannot be made strictly identical (§ 7 ), Δ s \Delta_{\text{s}} is read as an upper bound on the F1 difference associated with the typed state rather than as a point estimate.
sents.zh: 这两个对比都没有隔离出单一机制，并且由于统一基线提示词与任务特定提示词无法做到严格一致（§ 7 ），因此 Δ s \Delta_{\text{s}} 被解读为与类型化状态相关的 F1 差异的上界，而非点估计。

sents.en: Validation and error-propagation behaviour are examined separately (§ 6.5 , § 6.6 ).
sents.zh: 验证与错误传播行为将单独考察（§ 6.5 、§ 6.6 ）。

paragraphs.en: The original dataset is in English. To support the language-effect analysis, we produced a Portuguese variant by machine-translating each requirement with deep_translator (Google Translate, 2024). paragraphs.en: Classification (RQ1, language effect). The primary outcome is binary FR/NFR classification against PROMISE NFR+ labels, reported as Macro F1 (primary; it weights the F and NF classes equally despite the 255 vs. 370 imbalance), Accuracy, and the Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC). NFR subcategory F1 is diagnostic and computed over the ground-truth NF requirements also classified correctly as NF; subcategory precision is computed against every emission of that label in the condition. Categories with n < 30 n<30 (PO n = 1 n=1 , FT n = 10 n=10 , MN n = 17 n=17 , A n = 21 n=21 , SC n = 21 n=21 ) are excluded from the primary conclusions (§ 6.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 分类（RQ1，语言效应）。 主要结果是针对 PROMISE NFR+ 标签的二元 FR/NFR 分类，以宏平均 F1（主要指标；尽管存在 255 对 370 的类别不平衡，它对 F 与 NF 两类同等加权）、准确率以及马修斯相关系数（MCC）来报告。 NFR 子类别的 F1 仅作为诊断性指标，且只在那些被正确分类为 NF 的真实 NF 需求上计算；子类别的精确率则是针对该条件中每一次出现该标签的情况来计算。 样本量 n < 30 n<30 的类别（PO n = 1 n=1、FT n = 10 n=10、MN n = 17 n=17、A n = 21 n=21、SC n = 21 n=21）不纳入主要结论（§ 6.4）。

paragraphs.en: MoSCoW consistency (quality observation). As no priority ground truth exists, we measure inter-model agreement with Fleiss’ κ \kappa ( Fleiss, 1971 ) , treating the three models as raters, within each of the 6 (architecture × \times language) strata ( n aligned = 623 n_{\text{aligned}}=623 in all; the 2 dropped texts are the same alignment exclusion used for RQ1), interpreted with the Landis–Koch scale ( Landis and Koch, 1977 ) . To test whether the pipeline’s increment over the two-call baseline is distinguishable from zero, we run a paired percentile bootstrap ( B = 10,000 B=10{,}000 , same resampled indices for both architectures) on Δ ​ κ = κ pipeline − κ two-call \Delta\kappa=\kappa_{\text{pipeline}}-\kappa_{\text{two-call}} , with Bonferroni correction over N = 2 N=2 language strata ( α ′ = 0.025 \alpha^{\prime}=0.025 ). Because the bootstrap resamples requirements but not executions, we also re-executed the twelve pipeline and two-call conditions once and compare Δ ​ κ \Delta\kappa across the two executions and against the κ \kappa variation between repeated runs (§ 6.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: MoSCoW 一致性（质量观察）。 由于不存在优先级的真值标注，我们在每个 6 个（架构 × 语言）分层内，将三个模型视为评分者，使用 Fleiss' κ \kappa（Fleiss, 1971）测量模型间一致性（ n aligned = 623 n_{\text{aligned}}=623 全部一致；被剔除的 2 篇文本与 RQ1 使用的对齐排除相同），并按 Landis–Koch 标度（Landis and Koch, 1977）进行解释。 为检验流水线相对于两次调用基线的增量是否与零有显著区别，我们对 Δ ​ κ = κ pipeline − κ two-call \Delta\kappa=\kappa_{\text{pipeline}}-\kappa_{\text{two-call}} 运行配对百分位自助法（ B = 10,000 B=10{,}000 ，两种架构使用相同的重采样索引），并在 N = 2 N=2 个语言分层上进行 Bonferroni 校正（ α ′ = 0.025 \alpha^{\prime}=0.025 ）。 由于自助法只对需求而非执行进行重采样，我们还将十二个流水线与两次调用条件各重新执行了一次，并比较两次执行之间的 Δ ​ κ \Delta\kappa ，以及与重复运行之间的 κ \kappa 变异进行比较（§ 6.3）。

paragraphs.en: RQ1 paired comparison. For each of the 6 (model × \times language) pairs, the exact McNemar test ( McNemar, 1947 ) on the discordant pairs compares per-requirement outcomes of pipeline and baseline over n = 623 n=623 aligned requirements (joined by requirement text, since Requirement.id is regenerated on every load; two texts occur twice verbatim in PROMISE NFR+ and collapse to one key each, so n = 623 n=623 ; under exclusion a pair also needs a non-fallback prediction on both sides, giving effective n n of 621, 623, 623, 590, 623, and 622 for the six conditions). Because the outcomes are binary, the Wilcoxon signed-rank test ( Wilcoxon, 1945 ) on the same paired differences reduces to the same discordant-pair counts; it is the primary test on the fallback-excluded data, and we report both. Both test per-requirement correctness, not Macro-F1, so we also test the Macro-F1 differences directly with a paired bootstrap resampling requirements within each true class ( B = 10,000 B=10{,}000 ; Bonferroni-adjusted intervals, α ′ = 0.05 / 6 \alpha^{\prime}=0.05/6 , over the 6 comparisons per contrast). The effect size is Cohen’s h h ( Cohen, 1988 ) (thresholds 0.20 / 0.50 / 0.80 0.20/0.50/0.80 ). paragraphs.en: Uniform exclusion policy. paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ1: On requirements valid for both sides, the paired bootstrap supports a Macro-F1 difference in favour of the pipeline in 3 of 6 conditions (Bonferroni-adjusted). paragraphs.en: Because PT and EN classify the same requirements, the paired analysis is the appropriate one: aligning them by requirement text and applying the exact McNemar test (column p M p_{M} of Table 6 ; n = 623 n=623 , fallbacks retained, α ′ = 0.0056 \alpha^{\prime}=0.0056 ) shows a significant PT < < EN gap in five of nine cells: the baseline with qwen2.5:7b and llama3.1:8b , the pipeline with mistral:7b , and the two-call baseline with llama3.1:8b and mistral:7b . English is the better language in every significant cell, and only qwen2.5:7b is language-insensitive in both decomposed architectures ( p = 0.91 p=0.91 and 0.82 0.82 ). An earlier unpaired Mann–Whitney analysis, kept in Table 6 for comparison only, reached significance after correction only for the baseline with llama3.1:8b ( h = − 0.191 h=-0.191 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). That baseline llama3.1:8b result also depends on the exclusion policy: with the 33 EN fallbacks retained, the Mann-Whitney test gives p = 0.063 p=0.063 and no longer survives correction, while the paired test is significant ( p = 0.0009 p=0.0009 ).

paragraphs.en: Language-effect finding: Under the paired analysis, Portuguese is associated with significantly lower accuracy than English in 5 of 9 architecture–model cells, including decomposed architectures for mistral:7b and llama3.1:8b . We therefore do not claim that decomposition attenuates the language effect, nor present the results as evidence of multilingual portability. The data support only that qwen2.5:7b is language-insensitive under both decomposed architectures and that the baseline llama3.1:8b gap is not specific to that architecture. Because requirement and prompt language change together, and the Portuguese text is a machine translation, the gap cannot be attributed to either (§ 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 语言效应发现：在配对分析下，葡萄牙语在9个架构-模型组合中的5个里准确率显著低于英语，其中包括 mistral:7b 和 llama3.1:8b 的分解式架构。 因此，我们不声称分解能减弱语言效应，也不将这些结果呈现为多语言可移植性的证据。 数据仅支持以下结论：qwen2.5:7b 在两种分解式架构下均对语言不敏感，且基线模型 llama3.1:8b 的差距并非该架构所特有。 由于需求语言与提示语言同时变化，且葡萄牙语文本为机器翻译，因此该差距不能归因于其中任何一方（§ 7）。

paragraphs.en: The residual pipeline-vs-two-call difference is reproducible: a second execution of the twelve pipeline and two-call conditions (same code, seed, and configuration; the model server was updated in between, § 7 ) reproduced the sign of Δ ​ κ \Delta\kappa (PT + 0.022 +0.022 , EN + 0.079 +0.079 ) and of all four pairings of the two executions (PT + 0.022 +0.022 to + 0.041 +0.041 , EN + 0.052 +0.052 to + 0.097 +0.097 ), each exceeding the κ \kappa variation between repeated runs (at most 0.011 0.011 in PT and 0.027 0.027 in EN). With two executions the noise estimate is coarse, and the PT increment roughly halved (item-bootstrap 95% interval [ + 0.003 , + 0.041 ] [+0.003,+0.041] ), so we regard it as a reproducible association, not a precisely estimated effect. paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ2: Most of the F1 difference between the pipeline and the single-agent baseline is associated with decomposition and its task-specific prompts ( Δ p ∈ [ + 0.020 , + 0.075 ] \Delta_{\text{p}}\in[+0.020,+0.075] in 4 of 6 conditions), corroborated by the direct baseline-vs-two-call comparison; we cannot separate prompt wording from the extra call and staged context. paragraphs.en: Supplementary check with a larger model. To test whether the pipeline’s gain depends on the small models’ compliance, we ran the three architectures on gpt-4.1-mini (Azure AI Foundry), outside the 18-condition grid, with the same prompts, seed, and temperature; no classification output fell back. The pipeline outperforms the baseline in accuracy (PT + 0.019 +0.019 , McNemar p = 0.043 p=0.043 ; EN + 0.034 +0.034 , p < 10 − 4 p<10^{-4} , n = 623 n=623 ; only EN survives Bonferroni over two languages, α ′ = 0.025 \alpha^{\prime}=0.025 ). The gain is associated with decomposition: Δ p \Delta_{\text{p}} is + 0.013 +0.013 (PT, p = 0.17 p=0.17 ) and + 0.037 +0.037 (EN, p < 10 − 4 p<10^{-4} ), whereas Δ s \Delta_{\text{s}} is + 0.006 +0.006 (PT, p = 0.42 p=0.42 ) and − 0.003 -0.003 (EN, p = 0.63 p=0.63 ), reproducing the small-model pattern. paragraphs.en: The typed contract’s verifiable contribution is validation timing . In the pipeline, ClassificationOutput ’s Pydantic constraints (e.g., confidence in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ) are enforced immediately after the ClassificationAgent call, before the result enters PipelineState . In the two-call ablation the intermediate is a plain @dataclass , and Pydantic validation occurs only when the final output is assembled after the second call. paragraphs.en: To verify the boundary independently of the grid, we ran a systematic fault-injection campaign through the real agents of each architecture with a scripted LLM ( run_fault_injection_campaign.py ). It injects 13 faults into the model’s JSON, in either call: six value-range violations ( confidence 1.4 1.4 , − 0.5 -0.5 , NaN; priority_score 1.5 1.5 , − 0.1 -0.1 ; priority_rank 0 0 ) and seven parse-level faults (invalid or missing enumeration, wrong type, truncated JSON). The typed contract adds nothing for parse-level faults, which the two-call baseline and the pipeline handle identically (a flagged fallback after two calls). The difference lies in the value-range violations (Table 10 ). The typed pipeline rejects each where the typed object is built, detecting classification-stage faults after the first call and prioritisation-stage faults after the second, and keeps the requirement as a flagged fallback after two calls. The unvalidated two-call baseline passes the same values through its dataclass and fails when the output model is assembled, after the second call; because that failure propagates through the retry wrapper, both calls are repeated up to three attempts, consuming six calls before the requirement is dropped without a failure record. The single-call baseline contains all 13 faults at its one call, and no architecture let an out-of-range value reach the output. The campaign is synthetic: it characterises where each architecture detects a fault and what that costs, not how often such faults occur; that earlier validation prevents an operational failure remains an untested hypothesis. The six-call cost and the loss in the unvalidated arm partly reflect the shared retry policy, which retries a deterministic validation error, so the contrast is between a contained and an uncontained failure rather than between detection and non-detection.
paragraphs.zh: 为了独立于网格验证边界，我们通过每种架构的真实智能体，使用脚本化的 LLM 进行了系统性的故障注入实验（run_fault_injection_campaign.py）。 它向任一次调用中的模型 JSON 注入 13 个故障：六处取值范围违规（confidence 为 1.4、-0.5、NaN；priority_score 为 1.5、-0.1；priority_rank 为 0），以及七处解析层面故障（无效或缺失的枚举、错误的类型、截断的 JSON）。 类型化契约对解析层面故障没有带来任何增益，两类调用基线与流水线对此的处理方式相同（在两次调用后标记降级）。 差异体现在取值范围违规上（表 10）。 类型化流水线在构建类型化对象时即拒绝每个违规值：在第一次调用后检测出分类阶段故障，在第二次调用后检测出优先级排序阶段故障，并在两次调用后将需求保留为标记降级。 未经验证的两类调用基线让同样的值通过了其数据类，直到第二次调用后组装输出模型时才失败；由于该失败经由重试包装器传播，两次调用被重复执行至多三次尝试，消耗六次调用后需求被放弃且没有失败记录。 单次调用基线在其唯一一次调用中包含了全部 13 个故障，且没有任何架构让超范围值到达输出。 该实验是合成的：它刻画的是每种架构在何处检测到故障以及代价是什么，而非此类故障发生的频率；早期验证能否阻止运行时故障仍是一个未经检验的假设。 六次调用的开销以及未验证分支中的损失部分反映了共享的重试策略——它会对确定性的验证错误进行重试——因此对比是在受控失败与失控失败之间，而非在能否检测之间。

sents.en: The unvalidated two-call baseline passes the same values through its dataclass and fails when the output model is assembled, after the second call; because that failure propagates through the retry wrapper, both calls are repeated up to three attempts, consuming six calls before the requirement is dropped without a failure record.

paragraphs.en: The experiments indicate that the typed contract is accompanied by little difference in classification performance ( Δ s ∈ [ − 0.003 , + 0.013 ] \Delta_{\text{s}}\in[-0.003,+0.013] ). paragraphs.en: Practically, teams interested mainly in F1 should invest in better prompts rather than a typed contract, whereas applications that value earlier structural validation or cross-model consistency may prefer the pipeline despite its limited accuracy gain over the two-call baseline. paragraphs.en: Internal threats. PROMISE NFR+ has no MoSCoW ground truth, so prioritisation quality is operationalised as inter-model stability, reflecting reliability rather than correctness; some requirements also admit several plausible NFR categories while the dataset gives one label. The principal threat is the prompt–architecture confound: the baseline combines both subtasks in one prompt, so Δ p \Delta_{\text{p}} is a difference associated with the two-call variant, bundling prompt wording, an extra call, and staged context, and a call-count-controlled arm would be needed to separate them. Δ s \Delta_{\text{s}} likewise bundles the validation boundary, confidence handling (which fired for 3 of 3,750 predictions), and LangGraph orchestration, so it is a pipeline-versus-two-call contrast rather than an isolated typed-contract effect, and its range is an upper bound on the F1 difference associated with the typed contract. Cohen’s h h places all RQ1 effects below 0.20 0.20 but ignores the pairing; the paired g g is medium or large where estimable, so we do not call the effects negligible. For Δ s \Delta_{\text{s}} the 4–15 discordant pairs are too few for any reliable paired effect size. Excluding 38 fallbacks is an analyst’s decision, hence both readings; it changes one RQ1 verdict ( llama3.1:8b EN) and one Δ p \Delta_{\text{p}} estimate. Decoding at temperature 0 is not bit-deterministic: primary results come from one execution per condition, and the one repeated execution (pipeline and two-call) ran on a newer Ollama release (0.35.1 vs. 0.24.0), so its variation mixes run-to-run and server-version effects; differences below about one point of F1 (and 0.03 0.03 in κ \kappa ) should not be interpreted. The fault-injection evidence rests on 13 synthetic faults (six of them value-range violations, which extend the earlier five-value probe): it shows where validation occurs and what it costs, not how often such faults arise. Per-call traces were retained only for the two-call supplement runs, which limits audit of individual failures.
paragraphs.zh: 内部威胁。 PROMISE NFR+ 缺少 MoSCoW 真值，因此优先级排序质量以模型间稳定性来操作化，反映的是可靠性而非正确性；此外，部分需求可能对应多个合理的 NFR 类别，而数据集只给出一个标签。 主要威胁是提示与架构的混淆：基线在单一提示中合并了两个子任务，因此 Δ p \Delta_{\text{p}} 是与双调用变体相关的差异，它把提示措辞、额外一次调用和分阶段上下文捆绑在一起，需要一个控制调用次数的实验组才能将它们分离。Δ s \Delta_{\text{s}} 同样捆绑了验证边界、置信度处理（在 3,750 个预测中仅触发 3 次）以及 LangGraph 编排，因此它是流水线与双调用的对比，而非类型化契约的孤立效应，其范围是与类型化契约相关的 F1 差异的上界。 Cohen’s h h 将所有 RQ1 效应置于 0.20 0.20 以下，但忽略了配对结构；在可估计之处，配对 g g 达到中等或较大水平，因此我们不会称这些效应可忽略。 对于 Δ s \Delta_{\text{s}} ，4–15 个不一致配对数量过少，无法计算任何可靠的配对效应量。 排除 38 个回退情况是分析者的决定，因此存在两种解读；它改变了一个 RQ1 结论（ llama3.1:8b EN）和一个 Δ p \Delta_{\text{p}} 估计值。 温度为 0 的解码并非位级确定性：主要结果来自每个条件下的一次执行，而唯一一次重复执行（流水线与双调用）是在较新的 Ollama 版本上运行的（0.35.1 对比 0.24.0），因此其变异混合了运行间差异与服务器版本效应；低于约一个百分点 F1（以及 0.03 0.03 的 κ \kappa ）的差异不应被解读。 故障注入证据基于 13 个合成故障（其中六个为值域违规，是对早先五值探测的扩展）：它展示的是验证发生在何处以及代价是什么，而非此类故障出现的频率。 每次调用的轨迹仅为双调用补充实验所保留，这限制了对个别失败的审计。

paragraphs.en: External threats. All experiments use PROMISE NFR+ and three decoder-only SLMs (7–8B parameters) served through versioned Ollama tags, whose behaviour may change; compliance rates and the contribution of typed contracts may differ for other datasets, domains, or models, and the κ \kappa gain reflects only this three-model panel. The single larger model (§ 6.5 ) is one model with one execution per condition. The language comparison varies requirement and prompt language jointly, and the Portuguese text is a machine translation (back-translation BERTScore F1 0.9646; 624 of 625 pairs ≥ 0.90 \geq 0.90 ), so translation artefacts may contribute to the PT–EN gap. Only the pipeline used LangGraph, although the typed-state pattern is not specific to it. Bonferroni correction was applied throughout, and categories with fewer than 30 instances were excluded from the primary analyses. Our conclusions are therefore intentionally narrow: for the evaluated dataset, task, and model panel, the measurable differences that accompany the typed contract are earlier structural validation and a small difference in inter-model consistency, rather than improvements in classification accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 外部威胁。 所有实验均使用 PROMISE NFR+ 数据集和三个仅解码器架构的 SLM（7–8B 参数），通过带版本号的 Ollama 标签提供服务，其行为可能发生变化；对于其他数据集、领域或模型，合规率以及类型化契约的贡献可能有所不同，且 κ \kappa 的提升仅反映这三个模型的组合。 唯一一个更大的模型（§ 6.5）是单一模型，每个条件仅执行一次。 语言对比同时改变了需求语言和提示语言，且葡萄牙语文本为机器翻译（回译 BERTScore F1 为 0.9646；625 对中有 624 对 ≥ 0.90 \geq 0.90），因此翻译痕迹可能对 PT–EN 之间的差距有所影响。 只有该流水线使用了 LangGraph，尽管类型化状态模式并非专属于它。 全程采用 Bonferroni 校正，实例数少于 30 的类别被排除在主要分析之外。 因此，我们的结论有意保持谨慎的适用范围：在所评估的数据集、任务和模型组合上，类型化契约所带来的可测量差异是更早的结构性校验以及模型间一致性上的微小差异，而非分类准确率的提升。

The typed state is accompanied by two differences beyond accuracy: containment of out-of-range values at the agent boundary, with classification faults detected one call earlier in a 13-fault campaign (§ 6.6 ), and a small, reproducible increase in inter-model MoSCoW consistency (paired bootstrap, p < 0.001 p<0.001 in both languages, § 6.3 ). The design does not isolate their causes, and the limits are detailed in § 7 .
paragraphs.zh: 在所评估的设置中，准确率差异与分解为专用提示词有关，而与类型化状态无关（§ 6.1 – § 6.5）。 类型化状态除准确率外还伴随两项差异：在智能体边界处对越界值的遏制，在13个故障的实验中故障提前一次调用即被检测到（§ 6.6）；以及模型间MoSCoW一致性的小幅、可复现的提升（成对自助法检验，两种语言中均为 p < 0.001 p<0.001，§ 6.3）。 该设计并未隔离其成因，相关局限详见 § 7。

paragraphs.en: Future Work. (i) Calibrating the confidence threshold, to isolate routing from validation timing. (ii) A call-count-controlled arm to separate prompt wording from the extra call and staged context. (iii) Larger models and a larger rater panel, to test whether Δ s \Delta_{\text{s}} grows with capacity and the consistency gain generalises.
paragraphs.zh: 未来工作。 (i) 校准置信度阈值，以便将路由与验证时机分离开来。 (ii) 增加一个由调用次数控制的实验组，以区分提示措辞与额外调用及分阶段上下文的影响。 (iii) 使用更大的模型和更大的评分者小组，检验 Δ s \Delta_{\text{s}} 是否随模型能力增长，以及一致性增益是否具有普遍性。
